## Action specs (31)

The fuz_app protocol actions `heartbeat` (WS-only) and `peer/ping` are
registered too but omitted here — they belong to the shared runtime, not zzz
(`cancel` is a WS notification the read loop owns, not a spec).

- `completion_create` — Start an AI completion request, optionally with a progress token for streaming. Kind: request_response. Initiator: frontend. Auth: account=required, actor=none
- `completion_progress` — Streams a completion chunk to the frontend during a streaming AI response. Kind: remote_notification. Initiator: backend. Auth: public
- `directory_create` — Create a new directory on disk, and any missing parents, failing with `conflict` (`already_exists`) if the path is taken — never reuses an existing one. Kind: request_response. Initiator: frontend. Auth: account=required, actor=none
- `diskfile_create` — Create a new file on disk, failing with `conflict` (`already_exists`) if the path is taken — never overwrites. Kind: request_response. Initiator: frontend. Auth: account=required, actor=none
- `diskfile_delete` — Delete a file from disk. Kind: request_response. Initiator: frontend. Auth: account=required, actor=none
- `diskfile_read` — Read a file's contents as text, with their `hash`, its size, and timestamps. Any regular file in scope, except in a credential directory or a `.zzz` directory other than the app dir (`forbidden` / `protected_dir_not_allowed`); one over the size limit or not UTF-8 has `contents: null` and an `unloaded_reason`. Kind: request_response. Initiator: frontend. Auth: account=required, actor=none
- `diskfile_update` — Write new content to a file on disk, returning the written bytes' `hash`. With `expected_hash` (a `diskfile_read` `hash`), only if the file still holds those bytes — else `conflict` (`disk_changed`), nothing written. Kind: request_response. Initiator: frontend. Auth: account=required, actor=none
- `filer_change` — Notifies the frontend of a file system change detected by the watcher. Carries the file's metadata, not its contents — a client holding them reads them again (`diskfile_read`). Kind: remote_notification. Initiator: backend. Auth: public
- `job_cancel` — Cancel a job: a queued one never starts, the running one is stopped. A job that is already over is left as it is. Kind: request_response. Initiator: frontend. Auth: account=required, actor=none
- `job_changed` — A job was queued, started, progressed, or finished — its full current state. Kind: remote_notification. Initiator: backend. Auth: public
- `media_finalize` — Rewrite a recorded media file in place so its header has a duration and a seek index (an `ffmpeg` stream copy, nothing re-encoded). The container comes from the extension: WebM, Matroska, Ogg, MP4, MP3, WAV, FLAC, or AAC. Kind: request_response. Initiator: frontend. Auth: account=required, actor=none
- `ping` — Health check — echoes the request ID back to the caller. Kind: request_response. Initiator: both. Auth: account=none, actor=none
- `project_changed` — Notifies frontends when a project is opened, changed (a focus added or dropped, its registry resolved again), or closed. Kind: remote_notification. Initiator: backend. Auth: public
- `project_close` — Close a project — stops the file watching no other open project keeps and removes its root from ScopedFs. Kind: request_response. Initiator: frontend. Auth: account=required, actor=none
- `project_list` — List all open projects. Kind: request_response. Initiator: frontend. Auth: account=required, actor=none
- `project_open` — Open the project holding a file or directory — a trusted `repos.toml`'s root found above it, else its git checkout, else the directory — adding the root to ScopedFs and focusing the repo holding the path, whose files are then indexed and watched (a registry's root alone is indexed at its top level). The root must be strictly inside the daemon's home directory or named by `ZZZ_ROOTS_OUTSIDE_HOME`, and never `/`, the home directory or an ancestor of it, a pseudo-filesystem, or a protected directory (`forbidden` / `root_not_allowed`, `root_outside_home`, `protected_dir_not_allowed`); an untrusted or unconfined registry refuses the open (`forbidden` / `registry_untrusted`, `registry_not_confined`), as does one that can't be read or doesn't parse (`invalid_params` / `registry_unreadable`, `registry_invalid`) or was replaced while it was checked (`conflict` / `registry_changed`, opening again reads the new one), or a walk that can't be bounded (`internal_error` / `bound_unusable`); a registry entry that escapes the root is refused alone, its reason on the entry. `focus` asks for more registry entries to focus in the same open, each landing or refused alone (`refused`, with the code `repo_focus` would refuse it with); the root or the path's own focus that can't be listed fails the open. Kind: request_response. Initiator: frontend. Auth: account=required, actor=none
- `project_status` — Each entry's git status for an open registry project, from local refs (no fetch) — what's known now, with probes of the stale entries started, never awaited: poll while showing it and the statuses fill in. An entry is stale when its git dir's refs, HEAD, index, or stash moved, its focused checkout saw edits, it was never probed, `refresh` is set, or (one per poll) its status is a minute old. Refuses a root that isn't open (`invalid_params` / `project_not_open`) and a project that isn't a registry (`project_not_registry`). Kind: request_response. Initiator: frontend. Auth: account=required, actor=none
- `provider_load_status` — Check the availability and status of an AI provider. Kind: request_response. Initiator: frontend. Auth: account=required, actor=none
- `repo_files` — The index of a focused repo of an open project — what a client pulls for a focus another client made, which `project_changed` reports without its files. Refuses a root that isn't open (`invalid_params` / `project_not_open`) and a directory the project doesn't focus (`repo_not_focused`), rather than answering with no files, as an empty repo would. The check and the read see one state: a concurrent focus change lands wholly before or after. Kind: request_response. Initiator: frontend. Auth: account=required, actor=none
- `repo_focus` — Focus a registry entry of an open project — its files are then indexed and watched, as opening a path in it would, without resolving the registry again — and notify `project_changed` `update`, returning that repo's files alone; idempotent. Refuses a root that isn't open (`invalid_params` / `project_not_open`), a project that isn't a registry (`project_not_registry`), a directory that's none of its entries (`repo_not_in_project`), and an entry not yet cloned or gone since (`not_found`), or refused (`forbidden`), as last resolved (`repo_not_present` — opening the project again resolves it); a repo that can't be listed otherwise fails as `project_open`'s focused directory does (`forbidden` / `permission_denied`), leaving the project as it was. Kind: request_response. Initiator: frontend. Auth: account=required, actor=none
- `repo_unfocus` — Drop a registry entry from an open project's focus — its file watching stops unless another open project keeps it, and its files leave the index — and notify `project_changed` `update`; idempotent, and a registry may keep no focus. Refuses a root that isn't open (`invalid_params` / `project_not_open`), a project that isn't a registry, whose root stays focused while it's open (`project_not_registry`), and a directory that's none of its entries (`repo_not_in_project`). Kind: request_response. Initiator: frontend. Auth: account=required, actor=none
- `session_load` — Load the session snapshot (files, projects, terminals, jobs, provider status) — at boot and after each reconnect, to resync. Kind: request_response. Initiator: frontend. Auth: account=required, actor=none
- `terminal_ack` — Acknowledge a terminal's output up to a `terminal_data`'s `sent_bytes`. The backend stops reading a terminal whose output runs too far ahead of what an acknowledging WebSocket connection has taken, and resumes as acks arrive; connections that never acknowledge aren't waited for, and over HTTP the call does nothing. Fails with `not_found` when the caller has no live terminal with the id. Kind: request_response. Initiator: frontend. Auth: account=required, actor=none
- `terminal_close` — Kill a terminal process and return the exit code. Fails with `not_found` when the caller has no live terminal with the id. Kind: request_response. Initiator: frontend. Auth: account=required, actor=none
- `terminal_create` — Spawn a PTY process and return the terminal ID. A `cwd` must be absolute (`invalid_params` otherwise); a `command` that does not exist is `invalid_params` with `terminal_command_not_found`. Kind: request_response. Initiator: frontend. Auth: account=required, actor=none
- `terminal_data` — Stream stdout/stderr bytes from a terminal to the frontend. Kind: remote_notification. Initiator: backend. Auth: public
- `terminal_data_send` — Send stdin bytes to a terminal. Fails with `not_found` when the caller has no live terminal with the id. Kind: request_response. Initiator: frontend. Auth: account=required, actor=none
- `terminal_exited` — Notify the frontend that a terminal process exited naturally. Kind: remote_notification. Initiator: backend. Auth: public
- `terminal_resize` — Update PTY dimensions for a terminal. Fails with `not_found` when the caller has no live terminal with the id. Kind: request_response. Initiator: frontend. Auth: account=required, actor=none
- `transcription_create` — Queue a transcription of an audio file by the local speech model, and return its job. The transcript is written beside the file as `<name>.<model>.transcript.json`; fails with `conflict` (`already_exists`) if that model's transcript is already there. Kind: request_response. Initiator: frontend. Auth: account=required, actor=none
- `transcription_progress` — Segments a running transcription just decoded — a preview; the transcript file is written when the job succeeds. Kind: remote_notification. Initiator: backend. Auth: public
